_comment: Run calibrate.py once at your race resolution to fill these in. All coordinates are pixel boxes [x, y, width, height] on the primary monitor.

position.notes: Crop tightly around just the position number, e.g. 'P3'.

lap.notes: Crop around the lap counter, e.g. '2/3'.

pit_indicator.notes: Crop around where the pit icon/indicator appears. Save a reference crop as pit_icon_template.png for template matching.

drivers._comment: Map a race/session to a driver so updates can be attributed. Fill in per-race or pass driver name as a capture_agent.py argument.
